label: Rational fits of measured data
subgoals: Fit poles and residues to the frequency samples
Constrain every pole to the left half plane
Stamp the fitted state-space model as a dense block

label: Passivity and causality
subgoals: Test the real part of the fitted admittance for negative eigenvalues
Perturb the residues minimally to remove violations
Check that the impulse response is zero before time zero

label: Behavioral models in a netlist
subgoals: Encode only the behaviors the system test needs
Use smooth functions instead of abrupt switches
Document the conditions over which the model was fitted
